bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
src=cd7368f64f2f45e6a5359cde4d722c910a8d2845
stage="$root/.worktrees/userbot-report-cd7368f-20261115"
test -d "$root/.git" || test -f "$root/.git" || exit 61
mkdir -p "$root/.worktrees"
if [ -e "$stage" ]; then
 test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$src" || exit 62
else
 git -C "$root" fetch --no-tags origin "$src" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 63
 test "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$src" || exit 64
 git -C "$root" worktree add --detach "$stage" "$src" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 65
fi
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$src" || exit 66
test -z "$(git -C "$stage" status --porcelain)" || exit 67
cd "$stage"
PYTHONPATH=scripts python3 -m unittest scripts/test_userbot_resident_ipc.py >/tmp/gace-userbot-report-test.log 2>&1 || exit 68
echo USERBOT_REPORT_CODE_ONLY_TEST=PASS
echo USERBOT_SESSION_UNTOUCHED=YES
